summary: No reachable vulnerability. history.state (popstate and history.state in goHome) is only read through entryKey, which narrows to an object and compares the tlhTable value with === against an in-memory key; a forged or foreign state can at most send the Table to Home (a pause that writes nothing), which the user can do anyway. pushState writes only an opaque timeOrigin:counter key; no session data, replay code or hole cards go to history and the URL is unchanged (REQ-025 holds). Stored IndexedDB records: parseSessionRecord now bounds nextBotName to 0..MAX_SESSION_COUNT, which closes the TASK-2.6 MINOR (a corrupt record that would crash nextHand at a later bot bust is now rejected at read time and fails closed through the existing rejected path). The tableWritesSettled chain swallows write failures (already logged), so Home's read cannot hang on a failed write, and resolved links are not retained, so the chain does not grow without bound. No new dependencies, no network, no new randomness, no secrets, no innerHTML or other injection sinks in the diff.
